question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the construction of the 5,846 km-long, 4/6 lane Golden Quadrilateral route

options.text: It is part of the National Highways Development Project.
It will increase time, distance and cost of movement among mega cities.
The time, distance and cost of movement among the mega cities of India will be considerably minimised.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It will increase time, distance and cost of movement among mega cities.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Golden Quadrilateral **is a national highway network connecting several **major industrial, agricultural and cultural centres of India.**
 
• The Golden Quadrilateral project is managed by the **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)**__ under the Ministry of Road, Transport and Highways. __**Hence option 1st is correct.**__
 
• It forms a quadrilateral with all **four major metro cities** of India forming the vertices, viz., __**Delhi (north), Kolkata (east), Mumbai (west) and Chennai (south). Hence option 2nd is correct.**__
 
• The main objective of these super highways is to__** reduce the travel time between the major cities **__of India, running roughly along the perimeter of the country. __**Hence option 3rd is incorrect.**__
 
• The North–South corridor linking **Srinagar (Jammu and Kashmir) and Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu), **and East–West corridor linking **Silchar (Assam) and Porbandar (Gujarat)** are additional projects.
 
• These highway projects are implemented by the National Highway Authority Of India (NHAI).
 
• At **5,846 kilometers**, it is the largest highway project in India and the** fifth longest in the world.**
 
• It is the first phase of the National Highways Development Project (NHDP), and consists of two, four, and **six-lane express highways**, built at a cost of ₹600 billion (US$7.5 billion).
 
• The project was planned in 1999,** launched in 2001, and completed in July 2013**
 
• After completing this project The time,** distance and cost of movement among the mega cities of India will be considerably minimised.** __**Hence option 4the is correct**__
